what_happened.line: The Town Manager Screening Committee voted 4-0 by roll call to advertise the town manager job on GovHR and ICMA as well as MMA.
Members chose to try the three advertising venues first and revisit a retained recruiter in a few weeks if results are poor; one member will interview recruiters.

why_it_matters: The ad, and whether a search firm is hired, shape who applies to run the town's day-to-day operations, so the delay in wording and timing pushes back when candidates can start applying.
No approved salary range exists yet, and the pay offered will be set through the select board, which affects the cost of the position that goes into a future town budget.
